main_text.p: rium ufum cum alij diligentes doctiq; viri dialecticam revocare laborarunt: tum vero Petrus Ramus indefatigabili studio, & admirabili industria contedit. Nam in totius vitæ cursu, qui ei certe laboriosissimus fuit, nihil tam spectavit, quam ut ex Aristotelicis & Socraticis principijs ejusmodi dialecticam deduceret, quæ non solum syllogismū conficere doceret, & modum in utràq; partem disputandi monstraret: sed etiā quæ usum suum per omnes philosophos, poëtas, oratores, historicos extenderet, & amplissimè demonstraret. Quid autem effecerit, & quàm operam bonis literis præstiterit, non est meum dicere: siquidem hoc ejus præclarissima ingenii monumenta aperte testantur, & doctissimi viri in Germania, Anglia, Gallia, Polonia testantur. Ejusmodi dialecticam cum te quoque, nobilissime Magne, expetere, ad eamque animum applicare non ignorem: imò te jam in ea nec parum, nec infeliciter processisse exploratum habeam, me non absre facturum esse visum est, si hanc meam

page.notes: Page is a single column of roman type with long s rendered as s throughout. Printed text in the scan reads "rium ufum" at the top: the first word is a line fragment that continues from the previous page and is kept as a fragment. Several words are in the scan's own spelling and were copied as printed; the ligature-like "Q.uid" at the start of the fourth-from-last sentence was read as "Quid". Printed spelling ("contedit", "tcftantur", "ufum") is left as the printer set it, with u/v and i/j normalised per rule 5 where the letter was clear. Last line "meam" is set on the final line of the page, indented to the right, and ends the text mid-sentence, so no catchword is given. Words marked [?] were not fully certain: none required it. Signature and page number not printed.
